<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
namespace WorkerAdmin\Application\Chat;

use RuntimeException;
use WorkerAdmin\Contracts\PrivateValueCipher;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Identity\MobileNumber;

/** Read-only, bounded display projection. Never changes membership or user profiles. */
final class ChatParticipantProfiles
{
    private Database $db;
    private PrivateValueCipher $cipher;
    public function __construct(Database $db, PrivateValueCipher $cipher) { $this->db=$db; $this->cipher=$cipher; }
    private function id($value): string
    {
        if (!is_string($value) || preg_match('/^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$/D',$value)!==1
            || strlen($value)===20 && strcmp($value,'18446744073709551615')>0) throw new RuntimeException('展示范围无效',400);
        return $value;
    }
    public function read(string $actor,string $tokenHash,array $requests): array
    {
        $this->id($actor);
        if (!$requests || count($requests)>20 || array_keys($requests)!==range(0,count($requests)-1)) throw new RuntimeException('展示范围无效',400);
        $total=0;$seen=[];
        foreach($requests as &$request){
            if(!is_array($request)||array_diff(array_keys($request),['conversation_id','policy_version','sender_ids']))throw new RuntimeException('展示范围无效',400);
            $cid=$this->id($request['conversation_id']??null);$this->id($request['policy_version']??null);
            $ids=$request['sender_ids']??[];if(!is_array($ids)||count($ids)>50||$ids&&array_keys($ids)!==range(0,count($ids)-1))throw new RuntimeException('展示范围无效',400);
            foreach($ids as $id)$this->id($id);
            $total+=count($ids);if($total>100||isset($seen[$cid]))throw new RuntimeException('展示范围无效',400);
            $seen[$cid]=true;$request['sender_ids']=array_values(array_unique($ids));
        }unset($request);
        return $this->db->transaction(function()use($actor,$tokenHash,$requests):array{
            $login=$this->db->fetch("SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.expires_at) expires_unix FROM login_sessions s JOIN users u ON u.id=s.user_id AND u.status='active'
                WHERE s.user_id=:actor AND s.token_hash=:hash AND s.status='active' AND s.expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP()
                AND COALESCE(s.demo_actor_user_id,0)=0 AND COALESCE(s.test_actor_user_id,0)=0 AND COALESCE(s.test_instance_id,0)=0
                AND s.test_actor_expires_at IS NULL LIMIT 1 LOCK IN SHARE MODE",['actor'=>$actor,'hash'=>$tokenHash]);
            if(!$login)throw new RuntimeException('登录状态已失效',401);
            $items=[];
            foreach($requests as $request){
                $cid=$request['conversation_id'];$version=$request['policy_version'];
                $row=$this->db->fetch("SELECT c.scope_key,c.snapshot_hash applied_hash,CAST(c.policy_version AS CHAR) applied_version,
                    g.snapshot_json,g.snapshot_hash,CAST(g.policy_version AS CHAR) policy_version,o.order_source_type
                    FROM chat_conversations c JOIN chat_policy_guards g ON g.scope_key=c.scope_key
                    JOIN orders o ON o.id=g.order_id AND o.is_demo=0
                    JOIN chat_members cm ON cm.conversation_id=c.id AND cm.actor_id=:actor AND cm.actor_kind='mini' AND cm.can_read=1
                    WHERE c.id=:id AND c.conversation_type='order' LIMIT 1 LOCK IN SHARE MODE",['actor'=>$actor,'id'=>$cid]);
                if(!$row||$row['policy_version']!==$version||$row['applied_version']!==$version
                    || !hash_equals((string)$row['snapshot_hash'],hash('sha256',(string)$row['snapshot_json']))
                    || !hash_equals((string)$row['snapshot_hash'],(string)$row['applied_hash']))continue;
                $snapshot=json_decode((string)$row['snapshot_json'],true,32);
                if(!is_array($snapshot)||!in_array($snapshot['schema_version']??null,[1,2],true)||($snapshot['can_invite']??null)!==false||!in_array($snapshot['state']??'', ['open','readonly'],true)
                    ||($snapshot['scope_key']??'')!==$row['scope_key']||!is_array($snapshot['members']??null)||count($snapshot['members'])>10)continue;
                $roles=[];$allowed=false;
                foreach($snapshot['members'] as $member){
                    if(!is_array($member)||($member['kind']??'')!=='mini'||($member['can_read']??null)!==true
                        ||!in_array($member['role']??'', ['customer','worker','platform_staff'],true))continue;
                    $id=$this->id($member['actor_id']??null);
                    if($member['role']==='platform_staff'&&!$this->staffCurrent($snapshot,$member))continue;
                    $roles[$id]=$member['role'];if($id===$actor)$allowed=true;
                }
                if(!$allowed)continue;
                // Former authors are returned only if the viewer can see an actual
                // message from them in the Go-owned historical membership window.
                if($request['sender_ids']){
                    $params=['cid'=>$cid,'viewer'=>$actor,'version'=>$version];$slots=[];
                    foreach($request['sender_ids'] as $i=>$id){$key='sender'.$i;$slots[]=':'.$key;$params[$key]=$id;}
                    $authors=$this->db->fetchAll("SELECT DISTINCT CAST(cm.actor_id AS CHAR) actor_id,cm.role FROM chat_members cm
                        JOIN chat_messages m ON m.conversation_id=cm.conversation_id AND m.sender_id=cm.actor_id
                        JOIN chat_conversations history ON history.id=m.conversation_id
                        WHERE cm.conversation_id=:cid AND cm.actor_kind='mini' AND cm.actor_id IN (".implode(',',$slots).") AND m.policy_version<=:version AND m.seq>history.sync_floor_seq AND m.seq<=history.last_seq
                        AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM chat_member_intervals v WHERE v.conversation_id=m.conversation_id AND v.actor_id=:viewer
                        AND v.start_version<=m.policy_version AND (v.end_version IS NULL OR v.end_version>m.policy_version)) LIMIT 50",$params);
                    foreach($authors as $author)if(in_array($author['role'],['customer','worker','platform_staff'],true))$roles[(string)$author['actor_id']]=$author['role'];
                }
                $params=['assignment'=>$snapshot['assignment_id']];$slots=[];
                foreach(array_keys($roles) as $i=>$id){$key='actor'.$i;$slots[]=':'.$key;$params[$key]=$id;}
                $people=$this->db->fetchAll("SELECT CAST(u.id AS CHAR) actor_id,u.public_id,u.mobile_ciphertext,u.mobile_hmac,
                    rv.status real_name_status,rv.real_name_ciphertext
                    FROM users u LEFT JOIN assignments a ON a.id=:assignment
                    LEFT JOIN worker_profiles w ON w.id=a.worker_id AND w.user_id=u.id
                    LEFT JOIN worker_real_name_verifications rv ON rv.worker_id=w.id
                    WHERE u.status='active' AND u.id IN (".implode(',',$slots).") ORDER BY u.id",$params);
                $profiles=[];foreach($people as $person){
                    $id=(string)$person['actor_id'];$role=$roles[$id];
                    $kind=$role==='worker'?'worker':($role==='platform_staff'?'platform':($row['order_source_type']==='merchant'?'merchant':'user'));
                    $profiles[]=$this->display($person,$kind);
                }
                $items[]=['conversation_id'=>$cid,'policy_version'=>$version,'viewer_actor_id'=>$actor,'members'=>$profiles];
            }
            if((int)$login['expires_unix']<=time())throw new RuntimeException('登录状态已失效',401);
            return ['items'=>$items];
        });
    }
    private function staffCurrent(array $snapshot,array $member): bool
    {
        foreach(['0'=>(string)($snapshot['staff_config_version']??''),(string)$member['actor_id']=>(string)($member['authority_version']??'')] as $id=>$version){
            $current=$this->db->fetchValue('SELECT CAST(authority_version AS CHAR) FROM chat_staff_authority_versions WHERE user_id=:id LOCK IN SHARE MODE',['id'=>(string)$id]);
            if($version===''||(string)$current!==$version)return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    /** Public for independent display-rule tests; inputs are always server rows. */
    public function display(array $row,string $kind): array
    {
        if(!in_array($kind,['user','merchant','worker','platform'],true))throw new RuntimeException('展示身份无效',400);
        $suffix=substr(preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9]/','',(string)($row['public_id']??''))?:$this->id((string)$row['actor_id']),-6);
        $label=['user'=>'用户','merchant'=>'商家','worker'=>'师傅','platform'=>'平台工作人员'][$kind];
        $name=$label.$suffix;
        if($kind==='platform')$name=$label;
        elseif($kind==='worker'){
            if(($row['real_name_status']??'')==='approved'){
                $value=trim($this->cipher->decrypt((string)($row['real_name_ciphertext']??''),'worker-real-name'));
                if(preg_match('/^[\p{L}\p{M}· .-]{1,40}$/u',$value)===1)$name=$value;
            }
        }elseif(!empty($row['mobile_ciphertext'])&&!empty($row['mobile_hmac'])){
            $mobile=MobileNumber::normalize($this->cipher->decrypt((string)$row['mobile_ciphertext'],'user-mobile'));
            if($mobile!==''&&hash_equals((string)$row['mobile_hmac'],$this->cipher->hmac($mobile,'user-mobile')))$name=$label.substr($mobile,0,3).'****'.substr($mobile,-4);
        }
        return ['actor_id'=>$this->id((string)$row['actor_id']),'role'=>$kind,'display_name'=>$name,'avatar'=>$kind];
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Application\Chat;

use RuntimeException;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Auth;

/** Only exchanges an existing PHP identity; never creates a login or touches last_seen. */
final class ChatCredentialIssuer
{
    private Database $db;
    private array $config;
    private string $environment;

    public function __construct(Database $db, array $config, string $phpEnvironment)
    {
        $this->db = $db;
        $this->config = $config;
        $this->environment = ['testing'=>'test','development'=>'development','production'=>'production'][$phpEnvironment] ?? '';
    }

    public function exchangeMini(string $token, bool $audit = false): array
    {
        $this->assertEnabled();
        if (preg_match('/^[A-Fa-f0-9]{64}$/D', $token) !== 1) throw new RuntimeException('请重新登录', 401);
        // Match the original persisted login authority. Proxy/test identities are exported only as sanitized offline fixtures; they never borrow this production identity.
        $row = $this->db->fetch(
            "SELECT CAST(s.id AS CHAR) source_id,CAST(s.user_id AS CHAR) user_id,s.token_hash,
                    UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.expires_at) expires_unix
             FROM login_sessions s JOIN users u ON u.id=s.user_id AND u.status='active'
             WHERE s.token_hash=:token_hash AND s.status='active' AND s.expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP()
               AND COALESCE(s.demo_actor_user_id,0)=0 AND COALESCE(s.test_actor_user_id,0)=0
               AND COALESCE(s.test_instance_id,0)=0 AND s.test_actor_expires_at IS NULL LIMIT 1",
            ['token_hash'=>hash('sha256', $token)]
        );
        if (!$row) throw new RuntimeException('登录状态已失效，请重新进入', 401);
        $source = $this->id($row['source_id']);
        $actor = $this->id($row['user_id']);
        $hash = (string)$row['token_hash'];
        if (preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/D', $hash) !== 1) throw new RuntimeException('聊天身份暂不可用', 503);
        $auditVersion='';
        if($audit){
            $grant=$this->db->fetch('SELECT authority_version FROM chat_mini_auditors WHERE user_id=:id AND enabled=1',['id'=>$actor]);
            if(!$grant||preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/D',(string)$grant['authority_version'])!==1)throw new RuntimeException('当前账号无会话抽检权限',403);
            $auditVersion=(string)$grant['authority_version'];
        }
        return $this->issue([
            'sub'=>$actor,'kind'=>$audit?'mini_audit':'mini','source_id'=>$source,
            'session_id'=>hash('sha256', "mini\n".$source."\n".$hash),
            'session_version'=>$audit?hash('sha256',"mini-audit-v1\n".$source."\n".$hash."\n".$actor."\n".$auditVersion):hash('sha256', "mini-v1\n".$source."\n".$hash."\n".$actor),
            'scopes'=>[$audit?'chat:audit':'chat:use'],
        ], (int)$row['expires_unix']);
    }

    public function participantsMini(string $token,array $requests): array
    {
        $identity=$this->exchangeMini($token);
        return (new ChatParticipantProfiles($this->db,new \WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Security\GlobalPrivateValueCipher()))
            ->read((string)$identity['actor_id'],hash('sha256',$token),$requests);
    }

    private function assertEnabled(): void
    {
        \WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Chat\ChatRecoveryGate::assertReady($this->config,$this->environment);
        if (($this->config['enabled'] ?? false) !== true || $this->environment === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('聊天凭证交换未启用', 503);
        }
    }

    public function exchangeAdmin(Auth $auth): array
    {
        $this->assertEnabled();
        if (session_status() !== PHP_SESSION_ACTIVE || session_id() === '') throw new RuntimeException('请重新登录', 401);
        $admin = $auth->user();
        if (!$admin) throw new RuntimeException('请重新登录', 401);
        if (!empty($admin['must_change_password']) || !$auth->can('audit.view')) throw new RuntimeException('当前账号无聊天审计权限', 403);
        $scopes = ['chat:audit'];
        if ($auth->can('users.manage')) $scopes[] = 'chat:moderate';
        if ($auth->can('chat.images.review')) $scopes[] = 'chat:images';
        if ($auth->can('chat.media.review')) $scopes[] = 'chat:media';
        if ($auth->can('chat.evidence.view')) $scopes[] = 'chat:evidence';
        $scopeJSON = json_encode($scopes, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
        $adminID = $this->id($admin['id']);
        $sessionHash = hash('sha256', "admin\n".$this->environment."\n".session_id());
        $deadline = (int)($_SESSION['_last_activity'] ?? time()) + max(1, (int)\app_config('security.session_lifetime',7200));
        $expiry = min(time()+300, $deadline);
        if ($expiry <= time()) throw new RuntimeException('请重新登录',401);
        $expectedRole = (string)$admin['role'];
        $row = $this->db->transaction(function() use($adminID,$sessionHash,$scopeJSON,$expiry,$expectedRole): array {
            $current = $this->db->fetch("SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) id,role,password_hash FROM admin_users WHERE id=:id AND status IN ('active','1') AND must_change_password=0 FOR UPDATE",['id'=>$adminID]);
            if (!$current) throw new RuntimeException('请重新登录',401);
            if ((string)$current['role'] !== $expectedRole) throw new RuntimeException('后台权限已变化，请刷新页面',403);
            $authority = hash('sha256', "admin-v1\n".$adminID."\n".(string)$current['role']."\n".(string)$current['password_hash']."\n".$scopeJSON);
            $this->db->execute(
                "INSERT INTO chat_admin_sessions(admin_id,session_hash,session_version,authority_hash,scopes_json,expires_at,created_at)
                 VALUES(:admin_id,:session_hash,:version,:authority,:scopes,:expires,UTC_TIMESTAMP())
                 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE session_version=IF(revoked_at IS NOT NULL OR authority_hash<>VALUES(authority_hash),VALUES(session_version),session_version),
                 authority_hash=VALUES(authority_hash),scopes_json=VALUES(scopes_json),expires_at=VALUES(expires_at),revoked_at=NULL",
                ['admin_id'=>$adminID,'session_hash'=>$sessionHash,'version'=>bin2hex(random_bytes(32)),
                 'authority'=>$authority,'scopes'=>$scopeJSON,'expires'=>gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s',$expiry)]
            );
            $row = $this->db->fetch('SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) source_id,session_version,revoked_at FROM chat_admin_sessions WHERE session_hash=:hash AND admin_id=:admin_id LIMIT 1', ['hash'=>$sessionHash,'admin_id'=>$adminID]);
            if (!$row || $row['revoked_at'] !== null) throw new RuntimeException('请重新登录',401);
            return $row;
        });
        $_SESSION['chat_admin_session_id'] = $this->id($row['source_id']);
        return $this->issue(['sub'=>$adminID,'kind'=>'admin','source_id'=>$this->id($row['source_id']),
            'session_id'=>$sessionHash,'session_version'=>(string)$row['session_version'],'scopes'=>$scopes],$expiry);
    }

    private function id($value): string
    {
        $id = (string)$value;
        if (preg_match('/^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$/D', $id) !== 1 || strlen($id) === 20 && strcmp($id, '18446744073709551615') > 0) {
            throw new RuntimeException('聊天身份暂不可用', 503);
        }
        return $id;
    }

    private function issue(array $identity, int $sessionExpiry): array
    {
        $kid = (string)($this->config['key_id'] ?? '');
        $name = (string)($this->config['seed_env'] ?? '');
        if (preg_match('/^[a-z0-9_-]{1,32}$/D', $kid) !== 1 || preg_match('/^CHAT_[A-Z0-9_]{1,60}$/D', $name) !== 1 || !function_exists('sodium_crypto_sign_seed_keypair')) {
            throw new RuntimeException('聊天凭证配置不可用', 503);
        }
        $encoded = getenv($name);
        $seed = is_string($encoded) ? base64_decode($encoded, true) : false;
        if (!is_string($seed) || strlen($seed) !== SODIUM_CRYPTO_SIGN_SEEDBYTES || base64_encode($seed) !== $encoded) {
            throw new RuntimeException('聊天凭证配置不可用', 503);
        }
        $now = time();
        $expires = min($now + 300, $sessionExpiry);
        if ($expires <= $now) throw new RuntimeException('登录状态已失效，请重新进入', 401);
        $claims = array_merge($identity, [
            'iss'=>'bixuan-php:'.$this->environment,'aud'=>'bixuan-chat','env'=>$this->environment,
            'iat'=>$now,'nbf'=>$now,'exp'=>$expires,'jti'=>bin2hex(random_bytes(32)),
        ]);
        $header = ['alg'=>'EdDSA','typ'=>'JWT','kid'=>$kid];
        $input = $this->base64url(json_encode($header, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR)).'.'.$this->base64url(json_encode($claims, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES));
        $pair = sodium_crypto_sign_seed_keypair($seed);
        sodium_memzero($seed);
        $secret = sodium_crypto_sign_secretkey($pair);
        $signature = sodium_crypto_sign_detached($input, $secret);
        sodium_memzero($secret);
        sodium_memzero($pair);
        return ['access_token'=>$input.'.'.$this->base64url($signature),'token_type'=>'Bearer','actor_id'=>$identity['sub'],'environment'=>$this->environment,
            'expires_at'=>gmdate('Y-m-d\TH:i:s\Z', $expires),'expires_in'=>$expires-$now];
    }

    private function base64url(string $value): string { return rtrim(strtr(base64_encode($value), '+/', '-_'), '='); }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Http\Api\Modules;

use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;
use WorkerAdmin\Application\Chat\ChatCredentialIssuer;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;
use WorkerAdmin\Http\Api\ApiModule;

final class ChatCredentialApiModule implements ApiModule
{
    private Database $db;
    public function __construct(Database $db) { $this->db = $db; }
    public function supports(string $route): bool { return in_array($route,['chat.credentials','chat.audit.credentials','chat.participants'],true); }
    public function requiresContentSecurity(string $route): bool { return false; }
    public function dispatch(string $route): void
    {
        if (strtoupper((string)($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET')) !== 'POST') {
            header('Allow: POST');
            $this->fail('请求方式不正确', 'CHAT_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED', 405);
        }
        $authorization = (string)($_SERVER['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'] ?? '');
        if (preg_match('/^Bearer ([A-Fa-f0-9]{64})$/D', $authorization, $match) !== 1) $this->fail('请重新登录', 'CHAT_UNAUTHORIZED', 401);
        try {
            $issuer = new ChatCredentialIssuer($this->db, (array)\app_config('chat', []), (string)\app_config('app.env', 'production'));
            if($route==='chat.participants'){
                header('Cache-Control: private, no-store');
                $raw=file_get_contents('php://input',false,null,0,32769);
                $body=is_string($raw)&&strlen($raw)<=32768?json_decode($raw,true):null;
                if(!is_array($body)||array_keys($body)!==['conversations']||!is_array($body['conversations']))throw new RuntimeException('展示范围无效',400);
                $data=$issuer->participantsMini($match[1],$body['conversations']);
            }else $data=$issuer->exchangeMini($match[1],$route==='chat.audit.credentials');
            \json_response(['ok'=>true,'data'=>$data]);
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            // Deliberately don't pass the exception/SQL/token to the global API logger.
            $status = $exception instanceof RuntimeException && in_array($exception->getCode(),[400,401,403],true) ? $exception->getCode() : 503;
            $this->fail($status === 400 ? '展示范围无效' : ($status === 401 ? '登录状态已失效，请重新进入' : '聊天身份暂不可用，请稍后重试'),
                $status === 400 ? 'CHAT_INVALID_REQUEST' : ($status === 401 ? 'CHAT_UNAUTHORIZED' : ($status===403?'CHAT_FORBIDDEN':'CHAT_DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE')), $status);
        }
    }
    private function fail(string $message, string $code, int $status): void
    {
        \json_response(['ok'=>false,'code'=>$code,'message'=>$message,'request_id'=>\request_id(),
            'retryable'=>$status === 503,'server_time'=>gmdate('Y-m-d\TH:i:s\Z')], $status);
    }
}

<?php

namespace WorkerAdmin\Core;

use PDO;
use PDOException;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

class Database
{
    private $config;
    private $pdo;
    private $transactionDepth = 0;
    private $transactionRollbackOnly = false;
    private array $beforeCommitCallbacks = [];
    private bool $runningBeforeCommit = false;

    // 2026-08-14：统一 PDO 连接并强制真实预处理，兼容 MySQL 5.7.44。
    public function __construct(array $config)
    {
        $this->config = $config;
    }

    public function pdo()
    {
        if ($this->pdo instanceof PDO) {
            return $this->pdo;
        }
        if (!extension_loaded('pdo_mysql')) {
            throw new RuntimeException('服务器未安装 pdo_mysql 扩展。');
        }

        $host = isset($this->config['host']) ? $this->config['host'] : '127.0.0.1';
        $port = isset($this->config['port']) ? (int) $this->config['port'] : 3306;
        $database = isset($this->config['database']) ? $this->config['database'] : '';
        $charset = isset($this->config['charset']) ? $this->config['charset'] : 'utf8mb4';
        if ($database === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('数据库名称尚未配置。');
        }

        $dsn = sprintf('mysql:host=%s;port=%d;dbname=%s;charset=%s', $host, $port, $database, $charset);
        try {
            $this->pdo = new PDO($dsn, (string) $this->config['username'], (string) $this->config['password'], [
                PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
                PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
                PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false,
                PDO::ATTR_STRINGIFY_FETCHES => false,
                PDO::ATTR_TIMEOUT => 5,
            ]);
            $this->pdo->exec("SET SESSION sql_mode='STRICT_TRANS_TABLES,ERROR_FOR_DIVISION_BY_ZERO,NO_ENGINE_SUBSTITUTION'");
            $this->pdo->exec("SET time_zone='+00:00'");
        } catch (PDOException $exception) {
            throw new RuntimeException('数据库连接失败，请检查安装配置。', 0, $exception);
        }

        return $this->pdo;
    }

    /**
     * MySQL 原生预处理不允许在同一条 SQL 中重复使用同名占位符。
     * 这里仅展开重复命名参数，继续保持 ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES=false，避免各业务控制器重复踩坑。
     */
    private function prepareAndExecute($sql, array $params = [])
    {
        list($sql, $params) = $this->expandDuplicateNamedParameters((string) $sql, $params);
        $statement = $this->pdo()->prepare($sql);
        $statement->execute($params);
        return $statement;
    }

    private function expandDuplicateNamedParameters($sql, array $params)
    {
        if (!$params || strpos($sql, ':') === false) {
            return [$sql, $params];
        }

        $normalized = [];
        foreach ($params as $key => $value) {
            $normalized[ltrim((string) $key, ':')] = $value;
        }
        $seen = [];
        $expanded = [];
        $rewritten = preg_replace_callback('/(?<!:):([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\b/', function ($match) use (&$seen, &$expanded, $normalized) {
            $name = $match[1];
            if (!array_key_exists($name, $normalized)) {
                return $match[0];
            }
            $index = isset($seen[$name]) ? ++$seen[$name] : ($seen[$name] = 1);
            $target = $index === 1 ? $name : $name . '__dup' . $index;
            $expanded[$target] = $normalized[$name];
            return ':' . $target;
        }, $sql);

        // 保留未出现在 SQL 中的参数会触发 HY093；因此只传递实际匹配到的命名参数。
        // 本项目数据库层统一使用命名参数，若 SQL 没有匹配到占位符则沿用原参数以便显式暴露调用错误。
        return [$rewritten, $expanded ?: $params];
    }

    public function fetch($sql, array $params = [])
    {
        $statement = $this->prepareAndExecute($sql, $params);
        $row = $statement->fetch();
        return $row === false ? null : $row;
    }

    public function fetchAll($sql, array $params = [])
    {
        return $this->prepareAndExecute($sql, $params)->fetchAll();
    }

    public function fetchValue($sql, array $params = [])
    {
        return $this->prepareAndExecute($sql, $params)->fetchColumn();
    }

    public function execute($sql, array $params = [])
    {
        return $this->prepareAndExecute($sql, $params)->rowCount();
    }

    public function insert($sql, array $params = [])
    {
        $this->execute($sql, $params);
        return (int) $this->pdo()->lastInsertId();
    }

    /**
     * 共享连接的事务加入语义：只有最外层真正 begin/commit；内层 transaction 加入当前事务。
     * 任一内层回调抛错都会把整笔用例标记 rollback-only，即使上层业务误捕获异常，也禁止提交部分结果。
     */
    public function transaction(callable $callback)
    {
        $pdo = $this->pdo();
        $outermost = $this->transactionDepth === 0;

        if ($outermost) {
            $pdo->beginTransaction();
            $this->transactionRollbackOnly = false;
            $this->beforeCommitCallbacks = [];
        }
        $this->transactionDepth++;

        try {
            $result = $callback($this);

            if (!$outermost) {
                $this->transactionDepth--;
                return $result;
            }

            if ($this->transactionRollbackOnly) {
                throw new RuntimeException('事务已因内部失败标记为回滚，禁止提交部分业务结果。');
            }

            $this->runningBeforeCommit = true;
            ksort($this->beforeCommitCallbacks,SORT_STRING);
            foreach ($this->beforeCommitCallbacks as $beforeCommit) $beforeCommit($this);
            $this->runningBeforeCommit = false;
            if ($this->transactionRollbackOnly) throw new RuntimeException('事务已因内部失败标记为回滚，禁止提交部分业务结果。');
            $this->transactionDepth--;
            $pdo->commit();
            $this->resetTransactionState();
            return $result;
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            if ($this->transactionDepth > 0) {
                $this->transactionDepth--;
            }
            $this->transactionRollbackOnly = true;

            if ($outermost) {
                if ($pdo->inTransaction()) {
                    $pdo->rollBack();
                }
                $this->resetTransactionState();
            }
            throw $exception;
        }
    }

    /** Register bounded DML work after all outer/nested writes, before the same commit. */
    public function beforeCommit(string $key, callable $callback): void
    {
        if ($this->transactionDepth<1 || !$this->pdo()->inTransaction() || $this->runningBeforeCommit
            || $key==='' || strlen($key)>96 || (!isset($this->beforeCommitCallbacks[$key]) && count($this->beforeCommitCallbacks)>=128)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('预提交动作必须在原事务内登记且不得递归或超过上限');
        }
        $this->beforeCommitCallbacks[$key]=$callback;
    }

    private function resetTransactionState()
    {
        $this->transactionDepth = 0;
        $this->transactionRollbackOnly = false;
        $this->beforeCommitCallbacks = [];
        $this->runningBeforeCommit = false;
    }

    public function tableExists($table)
    {
        $count = $this->fetchValue(
            'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = :table',
            ['table' => $table]
        );
        return (int) $count > 0;
    }

    public function columnExists($table, $column)
    {
        $count = $this->fetchValue(
            'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = :table AND column_name = :column',
            ['table' => $table, 'column' => $column]
        );
        return (int) $count > 0;
    }
}

{
    public function hmac(string $plainText, string $context): string
    {

    }

    public function encrypt(string $plainText, string $context): ?string
    {
        return $plainText === '' ? null : \encrypt_private_value($plainText, $context);

/**
 * 中国大陆手机号值规则。纯函数，不依赖加密、数据库或 HTTP。
 */
final class MobileNumber
{
    public static function normalize(string $value): string
    {
        $value = trim($value);
        if ($value === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $digits = preg_replace('/\D+/', '', $value);
        if (!is_string($digits)) {
            return '';
        }
        if (strpos($digits, '0086') === 0) {
            $digits = substr($digits, 4);
        } elseif (strpos($digits, '86') === 0 && strlen($digits) === 13) {
            $digits = substr($digits, 2);
        }

        return preg_match('/^1\d{10}$/', $digits) === 1 ? $digits : '';
    }

    private function __construct()
    {
    }
}

<?php

namespace WorkerAdmin\Core;

use RuntimeException;

class Auth
{
    private $db;
    private $userLoaded = false;
    private $user;

    private $permissions = [
        'operations' => ['chat.images.review', 'chat.media.review', 'dashboard.view', 'orders.manage', 'workers.manage', 'users.view', 'users.manage', 'catalog.manage', 'help.manage', 'reviews.manage', 'disputes.manage', 'audit.view'],
        'finance' => ['dashboard.view', 'orders.view', 'payments.manage', 'refunds.manage', 'commissions.manage', 'withdrawals.manage', 'audit.view'],
        'viewer' => ['dashboard.view', 'orders.view', 'users.view'],
    ];

    public function __construct(Database $db)
    {
        $this->db = $db;
    }

    // 2026-08-14：登录包含失败锁定、会话轮换和密码哈希升级。
    public function attempt($username, $password)
    {
        $username = trim((string) $username);
        $user = $this->db->fetch('SELECT * FROM admin_users WHERE username = :username LIMIT 1', ['username' => $username]);
        if (!$user || !in_array((string) $user['status'], ['active', '1'], true)) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!empty($user['locked_until']) && strtotime($user['locked_until'] . ' UTC') > time()) {
            throw new RuntimeException('登录失败次数过多，请稍后再试。');
        }

        if (!password_verify((string) $password, $user['password_hash'])) {
            $attempts = (int) $user['failed_attempts'] + 1;
            $max = (int) \app_config('security.login_max_attempts', 5);
            // 2026-08-14：锁定时间按 UTC 写库，与订单及审计时间约定保持一致。
            $lockedUntil = $attempts >= $max ? gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s', time() + ((int) \app_config('security.login_lock_minutes', 15) * 60)) : null;
            $this->db->execute('UPDATE admin_users SET failed_attempts=:attempts, locked_until=:locked_until, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=:id', [
                'attempts' => $attempts, 'locked_until' => $lockedUntil, 'id' => $user['id'],
            ]);
            return false;
        }

        if (password_needs_rehash($user['password_hash'], PASSWORD_BCRYPT, ['cost' => 12])) {
            $this->db->execute('UPDATE admin_users SET password_hash=:hash WHERE id=:id', [
                'hash' => password_hash((string) $password, PASSWORD_BCRYPT, ['cost' => 12]), 'id' => $user['id'],
            ]);
        }

        $this->revokeChatIdentity();
        session_regenerate_id(true);
        $_SESSION['admin_id'] = (int) $user['id'];
        $_SESSION['admin_login_at'] = time();
        $this->db->execute('UPDATE admin_users SET failed_attempts=0, locked_until=NULL, last_login_at=NOW(), last_login_ip=:ip, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=:id', [
            'ip' => \request_ip(), 'id' => $user['id'],
        ]);
        $this->userLoaded = false;
        $this->user = null;
        \csrf()->rotate();
        return true;
    }

    public function user()
    {
        if ($this->userLoaded) {
            return $this->user;
        }
        $this->userLoaded = true;
        if (empty($_SESSION['admin_id'])) {
            return $this->user = null;
        }
        // 2026-08-14：管理员表不保存手机号，避免查询不存在字段导致登录后页面报错。
        $this->user = $this->db->fetch('SELECT id, username, real_name, role, status, must_change_password, last_login_at, last_login_ip, created_at FROM admin_users WHERE id=:id LIMIT 1', ['id' => (int) $_SESSION['admin_id']]);
        if (!$this->user || !in_array((string) $this->user['status'], ['active', '1'], true)) {
            $this->logout();
            return null;
        }
        return $this->user;
    }

    public function check()
    {
        return $this->user() !== null;
    }

    public function logout()
    {
        $this->revokeChatIdentity();
        $this->user = null;
        $this->userLoaded = true;
        unset($_SESSION['admin_id'], $_SESSION['admin_login_at']);
        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_ACTIVE) {
            session_regenerate_id(true);
        }
    }

    private function revokeChatIdentity(): void
    {
        if (empty($_SESSION['chat_admin_session_id'])) return;
        try {
            $this->db->execute('UPDATE chat_admin_sessions SET revoked_at=COALESCE(revoked_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP()) WHERE id=:id AND admin_id=:admin_id',
                ['id'=>(string)$_SESSION['chat_admin_session_id'],'admin_id'=>(string)($_SESSION['admin_id'] ?? '0')]);
        } catch (\Throwable $error) {
            // Don't report successful logout if persistent chat revocation failed.
            throw new RuntimeException('聊天会话暂时无法撤销，请稍后再试。');
        }
        unset($_SESSION['chat_admin_session_id']);
    }

    public function can($permission)
    {
        $user = $this->user();
        if (!$user) {
            return false;
        }
        if ($user['role'] === 'super_admin') {
            return true;
        }
        $grants = isset($this->permissions[$user['role']]) ? $this->permissions[$user['role']] : [];
        if (in_array($permission, $grants, true)) {
            return true;
        }
        if (substr($permission, -5) === '.view') {
            return in_array(str_replace('.view', '.manage', $permission), $grants, true);
        }
        return false;
    }

    public function requireLogin()
    {
        if (!$this->check()) {
            \redirect(\admin_url('login'));
        }
    }

    public function requirePermission($permission)
    {
        $this->requireLogin();
        if (!$this->can($permission)) {
            http_response_code(403);
            echo \view('errors/403', ['pageTitle' => '无权访问']);
            exit;
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace WorkerAdmin\Core;

use RuntimeException;

class Csrf
{
    // 2026-08-14：所有后台写操作统一使用会话 CSRF 令牌。
    public function token()
    {
        if (empty($_SESSION['_csrf_token'])) {
            $_SESSION['_csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
        }
        return $_SESSION['_csrf_token'];
    }

    public function input()
    {
        return '<input type="hidden" name="_token" value="' . \e($this->token()) . '">';
    }

    public function validate($token)
    {
        return is_string($token) && hash_equals($this->token(), $token);
    }

    public function verifyRequest()
    {
        $token = isset($_POST['_token']) ? $_POST['_token'] : (isset($_SERVER['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN']) ? $_SERVER['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'] : '');
        if (!$this->validate($token)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('页面已过期，请刷新后重试。');
        }
    }

    public function rotate()
    {
        $_SESSION['_csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
        return $_SESSION['_csrf_token'];
    }
}
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Http\Admin;

use WorkerAdmin\Core\Auth;
use WorkerAdmin\Core\Csrf;

final class AdminRequestGuard
{
    private Auth $auth;
    private Csrf $csrf;

    public function __construct(Auth $auth, Csrf $csrf)
    {
        $this->auth = $auth;
        $this->csrf = $csrf;
    }

    public function inspect(string $route): void
    {
        if ($route === 'chat.credentials') {
            $status = 0;
            if (strtoupper((string)($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET')) !== 'POST') {
                header('Allow: POST'); $status = 405;
            } elseif (!$this->auth->check()) { $status = 401;
            } elseif (!empty($this->auth->user()['must_change_password'])) { $status = 403;
            } else {
                try { $this->csrf->verifyRequest(); } catch (\RuntimeException $error) { $status = 403; }
            }
            if ($status) \json_response(['ok'=>false,'code'=>$status===401?'CHAT_UNAUTHORIZED':($status===405?'CHAT_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED':'CHAT_FORBIDDEN'),
                'message'=>'请刷新页面后重试','retryable'=>false,'request_id'=>\request_id(),'server_time'=>gmdate('Y-m-d\TH:i:s\Z')],$status);
            return;
        }
        if ($route === 'login') return;
        $this->auth->requireLogin();
        $user = $this->auth->user();
        if (!empty($user['must_change_password']) && !in_array($route, ['profile','profile.password','logout'], true)) {
            \flash('warning', '首次登录必须先修改演示密码。');
            \redirect(\admin_url('profile'));
        }
        if (strtoupper((string)($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET')) === 'POST') {
            $this->csrf->verifyRequest();
        }
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);
namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Chat;

use RuntimeException;

/** Independent control marker; never stored inside a DB backup or release tree. */
final class ChatRecoveryGate
{
    public static function ready(array $config,string $environment): bool
    {
        $path=(string)($config['recovery_gate_file']??'');$epoch=(string)($config['recovery_epoch']??'');
        if($path===''&&$epoch==='')return in_array($environment,['test','development'],true);
        if(!self::path($path)||preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/D',$epoch)!==1||!is_file($path)||is_link($path)||filesize($path)>1024||(fileperms($path)&0022)!==0)return false;
        $raw=file_get_contents($path);if(!is_string($raw))return false;
        $m=json_decode($raw,true);
        if(!is_array($m)||array_keys($m)!==['schema','environment','epoch','state'])return false;
        if(json_encode($m,JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES)!==preg_replace('/\s+(?=(?:[^"]*"[^"]*")*[^"]*$)/','',$raw))return false;
        return$m===['schema'=>1,'environment'=>$environment,'epoch'=>$epoch,'state'=>'ready'];
    }
    public static function assertReady(array $config,string $environment): void
    {if(!self::ready($config,$environment))throw new RuntimeException('聊天安全恢复尚未核验',503);}
    public static function path(string $path): bool
    {return$path!==''&&($path[0]==='/'||preg_match('/^[A-Za-z]:[\\\\\/]/D',$path)===1)&&strpos($path,"\0")===false;}
}
